notes: Source 4 = Callaway 1970 (Kh. Khudriya = the 'Ai expedition's Site F); one paragraph only. s4f1-s4f2: the industrial complex lies 'on the terrace north of the church'; the church is the spot where Site F was located, so the direction is coded from the site (relative_to unit). The three cisterns are coded as one feature. s4f3: 'tombs cut into the south side of the wadi' read as rock-cut tombs (cavity_with_opening true); Fig. 2 also shows the tomb crosses F1-F16 N and NE of the Site F circle. s4f4: the source says 'over one kilometer' east; 1000 is a lower bound, not a measured distance. Not coded: wine press and 'series of storage vats' (vats are not pools or pits). No plan position: Fig. 2 marks Site F by a circle but has no coordinates, so the unit's recorded point cannot be placed on it.
